sources.title: Interview note preserving the original multithreaded array-sort wording
Tagged question record for the multithreaded array-sort source
Deterministic Java differential oracle for the candidate implementation

claims.text: The raw repository source preserves only the request to implement array sorting with multiple threads; it does not preserve a language, element type, sort direction, stability requirement, thread count or required algorithm.

Java int[] ascending in-place sorting, caller-supplied parallelism and threshold, Fork/Join plus merge sort, and the argument rejection rules are explicit answer-side choices made to provide a complete executable contract.
The committed implementation matches a deterministic Arrays.sort oracle across 305 generated cases and declared edge/error cases under parallelism values 1, 2, 3, 4 and 8.
